title: Workspace
summary: Keep projects, files, context, and delivery state together in one working surface.

sections.heading: Organize projects
body: A workspace groups the files, instructions, and state needed for a software task.

sections.heading: Preserve context
body: Keep project context close to the code so people and agents can work from the same source of truth.
